title: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India, (1984) 3 SCC 161
content.facts: A public-interest petition alleged bonded labour and violations of dignity and liberty.
questionsBeforeCourt: How should the Court respond to a continuing public-law violation affecting vulnerable persons?
content.ratioDecidendi: Constitutional courts may use flexible procedure and continuing directions to enforce Fundamental Rights of persons unable to litigate effectively.
content.holding: SC affirmed epistolary jurisdiction and appointed advocate-commissioners to inspect bonded stone quarries.
content.relevance: Court inquiry commissions and procedural flexibility under Article 32(2).
